name: Carlo
source:
He is a dragon who think that human beings are weak and boring.
At the first meeting with heroine, as he was taken away the horn and a part of magical power,
he is working together with her to observe. 

"I just keep protecting my beloved wife with every efforts."

[From Google Play]
